given: a SKU's stock record carries a combined tracking code
when: the operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: the combined tracking code is displayed on the record so the operator can identify the units

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the per-location rows (location + quantity) are listed for the SKU. This AC adds the display of the combined tracking code, a distinct data dimension: the rows can list correctly while the tracking code is omitted, and the tracking code can render while the row listing is wrong, so each is independently breakable.

architectural_notes: Same read boundary as AC1 (app/routes/, renders_via react): the per-record combined tracking code is a field on each stock row surfaced by the detail JSON payload. The repository (app/repositories/) SELECT projects the tracking-code column exactly as filed; the service (app/services/) passes it through without transformation and the React SPA (client/) displays it. No cross-cutting concern beyond faithful field passthrough — the tracking code must round-trip from the persisted stock row to the boundary response verbatim.
